abstract.t: This document defines the required-rate (r) priority parameter for the Extensible Prioritization Scheme for HTTP (RFC 9218). The parameter allows a client to indicate a delivery rate above which faster transfer of an HTTP response is not expected to provide additional application benefit. A server can use this signal to rate-limit an individual response, allowing other eligible responses to make progress without replacing the urgency and incremental scheduling behavior defined by RFC 9218.
